debate.why: Senate candidates Jon Ossoff and Mike Collins argue opposite positions in a moderated debate, and in their timed rebuttals they answer each other by name.

exchanges.motion: Should private firearm sales require a background check?
exchanges.a_side: Require background checks before every firearm sale or transfer
exchanges.b_side: Gun buyers already get background checks
exchanges.hook_topic: on background checks for gun sales
exchanges.retention: It opens with "It's a simple background check before the sale or the transfer of a firearm" and then asks why Mike Collins opposes it. Viewers stay to hear whether Collins can defend saying no, and he answers that buyers already get a background check at the store.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: It's a simple background check before the sale or the transfer of a firearm.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: He just said he opposes that. Why?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: When you go into the store to buy a weapon, you have a background check.
